title: Normal skin from donor AR001 [NS-AR001]
characteristics_ch1_4: cell type: Epidermal and dermal cells
extract_protocol_ch1_1: 6-mm punch biopsies were taken from healthy skin from healthy donors, lesional and non-lesional skin from psoriasis patients.
extract_protocol_ch1_2: Samples were incubated overnight in 0.4% dispase (Life Technologies) in Hank’s Balanced Saline Solution (Gibco) at 4°C. Epidermis and dermis were separated. Epidermis was digested in 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA (Gibco) with 10U/mL DNase I (Thermo Scientific) for 1 hour at 37°C, quenched with FBS (Atlanta Biologicals), and strained through a 70μM mesh. Dermis was minced, digested in 0.2% Collagenase II (Life Technologies) and 0.2% Collagenase V (Sigma) in plain medium for 1.5 hours at 37°C, and strained through a 70μM mesh. Epidermal and dermal cells were combined in 1:1 ratio and libraries were constructed by the University of Michigan Advanced Genomics Core on the 10X Chromium system.
data_processing_1: Libraries were sequenced using a NovaSeq6000 SP 100-cycle flow cell (Illumina).
data_processing_2: Fastq files were generated using Cellranger mkfastq (version 4.0.0). The raw reads were mapped to the  human genome (hg38) using cellranger count.
data_processing_3: Multiple samples were aggregated by cellranger aggr.
data_processing_5: Supplementary_files_format_and_content: csv file with raw gene counts for every gene and every cell
